issue_request: FHIR-11076 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification Patient Care DSTU2 ballot issue asking to clarify the distinction between Condition and Observation. The resolution pointed to tracker 8872 for the boundary clarification and tracker 10090 for Condition scope and concern guidance.
initial_application: No source commit names FHIR-11076 directly. Historical commit f5f5c6ecae applied tracker 8872 by adding Condition/Observation boundary text, and df58ee3f55 applied tracker 10090 by rewriting the Condition introduction and preserving that boundary guidance.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini and source/condition/condition-introduction.xml is current-build source. Later Published issue FHIR-26904 refined the same boundary with nursing problem-list and Condition-instance versus patient-state language. Later R6 proposals FHIR-56690 and FHIR-57327 are Submitted/Triaged, so their proposed wording is not final authority for this applied/published reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Scope and Usage text covers conditions, problems, diagnoses, and concerns; the Boundaries and Relationships text explains typical Observation use for signs/symptoms, Condition use for persistent or managed symptoms, and Observation use for resolved or diagnostic-contributing symptoms.
